description.value: Prospect Point Cafe sits at the highest point in Stanley Park, offering locally roasted Moja coffee, fresh baked goods, sandwiches, salads, and handcrafted Rocky Point Ice Cream with sweeping views of Lions Gate Bridge, Burrard Inlet, and the North Shore Mountains. It is a historic landmark on the Stanley Park Seawall, one of the most popular cycling routes in British Columbia, and is operated by the Capilano Group. The venue also hosts events for up to 400 guests and includes a gift shop (The Trading Post) on site.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 21m; rack at 27m; rack (8 spaces) at 37m. Total: 18 spaces.
